summary: The new web guard measures the wall to the part's bounding box only, so a pocket 0.05 mm from an inner face of a non-box outline (L plate notch) or from the side of a boss on a plate is built with the wall silently lost, and rows 86/87 and the pocket supported rows cover this class. The guard works for flat rectangles, diamonds, mirrors and two-pocket cases, and 8 stored cases replay exactly. Ordinary row-of-holes and normal-spacing grids are not over-refused (only very large plates, 500x300, refuse a 3 mm wall).

defects.problem: Guard checks the wall against the bbox of the body only. L-plate 60x40x10 (polygon [[0,0],[60,0],[60,20],[30,20],[30,40],[0,40]]), 10x6 pocket depth 4 with 0.05 mm wall to the notch face x=30: guard ON builds, volume 17760 expected, got 1.2 mm3 too high (rel 6.8e-5, equals the lost wall 0.05*6*4); same for the wall under the notch edge y=20 (rel 1.1e-4). No refusal, silently wrong solid.

Pocket cut into a joined boss (plate 60x40x10 + 20x20x5 boss, pocket 10x6x3 on the boss top) leaving 0.05 mm to the boss side: guard ON builds, closed form 25820, got +0.9 mm3 (rel 3.5e-5 = 0.05*6*3), the thin wall is lost. The guard only sees the plate bbox, not the boss sides.

1% of the diagonal scales with the part: a 500x300x10 plate refuses a pocket 3 mm from the edge (limit 5.8 mm) although loss was measured only below about 0.26% of the diagonal (1.5 mm there). Honest refusal, but over-wide on large parts.

notMeasured: Tapered/slanted-wall pockets and repeatAround pockets with a thin wall between copies were not probed.
Triangle plate with a pocket 0.05 mm from the slanted edge was NOT lost (V2 exact), a slanted outer edge is not a confirmed hole.
repeat(r1) of a repeat result adds only ONE pocket (3 pockets, not 4) in the script layer; I did not check the language intent against OCCT, so my 2x2 grid cases V13/O2 are not scored.
Wall to non-box outlines with circular outer edges not probed (no closed form).
